subject: [PATCH v2 05/17] selftests/mm: move is_backed_by_folio() into vm_util

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch moves the is_backed_by_folio() function from split_huge_page_test.c to vm_util.c, making it available for use in other tests. The function checks if an address range is backed by a folio of a given order by reading the compound head and tail flags from /proc/kpageflags. This change allows for more reuse of code across different selftests and does not introduce any functional changes.
